mentions.name: Provision
mentions.description: This tool runs a team of OpenClaw AI agents without needing Mac minis, giving each agent a dedicated email inbox (powered by Mailboxkit) and a dedicated Chrome browser that can be connected remotely to unblock the agent if needed; it is currently in pilots with a few startups.
mentions.problem: Running a team of OpenClaw agents without burning money on Mac minis.
mentions.source_excerpt: Provision (provision.ai) - how I run a team of openclaw agents without burning money on Mac minis. Each agent is given a dedicated email inbox (powered by Mailboxkit) and a dedicated chrome browser that you can connect via browser to unblock if needed. Currently doing some pilots with a few startups.
